operator: Mashhad BRT (اتوبوس تندرو) — Bus Org corridors run by Vahed Seir & Avaran Seir Rezvan
notes:
Sources: FA Wikipedia "سامانه اتوبوس تندرو مشهد" (route/line structure: Line 1=800 Vahed Seir, Line 2=800/802, Line 3=12/830/831 Avaran Seir Rezvan, operator سازمان اتوبوسرانی مشهد / Mashhad Bus Org); OpenStreetMap route relations (WGS-84, correct — machine-readable ordered stop lists) via Overpass mail.ru mirror (overpass-api.de and kumi were down/500 during the build). Six BRT route relations were found and used: r5658288/r13090062 (ref 800, Terminal Imam Reza ↔ Terminal Tabarsi, Line 1); r5762269/r12943356 (ref 12, Terminal Vakilabad ↔ Haram Shirazi, Line 3); r13078659/r13078660 (ref 831, Terminal Elahieh ↔ Terminal Mosalla, Line 3). All 199 stop nodes + ordering + coordinates come directly from these OSM relations — no invented stops. neshan.org line pages (800/831) confirmed the same terminals but are JS-rendered behind a browser-check so could not be scraped for text; bus.mashhad.ir / map.mashhad.ir and the official Bus Org PDF were not directly parseable in this environment.

Service model: FA Wikipedia + Mashhad municipality announcements give operating hours ~05:00–21:30 daily (some sources 05:30–23:00); line 12 historically ran later. No published per-line headway/timetable was found, so trips use an EVEN 10-minute headway across 05:00–21:30 every day (calendar service_id=DAILY, all 7 days). Inter-stop times are MODELLED from geodesic distance at ~19.8 km/h avg incl. a 20s dwell — realistic for trunk BRT but NOT a published timetable, which is the main reason confidence is ~0.6 rather than higher.

Feed contents: this structured feed carries the full stop inventory (199 stops), all 3 routes, a DAILY calendar, and ONE representative trip per direction per route (6 trips, 230 ordered stop_times) with full station ordering — exactly satisfying "≥1 representative trip per direction". The generator also produced the full even-headway set (~560 trips / ~21k stop_times across 05:00–21:30) which can be expanded identically from the same headway model. stop_name is bilingual "English translit / Persian". A few translit tokens leaked mid-string (e.g. "Sq Moallem", "استقلال 7", "Shohada Sqی مسجد گوهرشاد") but the exact Persian name is preserved in every stop so identity is unambiguous. Note line 2 (800.2/802) and line 830 branch were named in Wikipedia but had no OSM route relation, so they are not included (would be unevidenced ordering). Timezone Asia/Tehran.
